notes: Pressing your interact key now stops the assistant until you're done. Casting mid-interaction turns your character and cancels it, so the door never opens — now pressing E (or whatever you've bound interact to; the game's own action is what's watched, so your keybinds are respected) holds the DC caster AND the healer until the interaction has finished. Where the game reports the interaction — a cast bar, a conversation, a chest or reward panel — it waits for exactly as long as that lasts, then adds a moment for the animation to finish. For instant things like a plain door, which report nothing, it falls back to a short pause. Movement keys deliberately don't trigger it, and every hold has a time limit, so a missed signal costs a couple of seconds rather than stopping the assistant for the rest of the quest. New 'Pause on interact' switch in the panel, on by default.
